headline_finding: There is no large, clean, unencumbered pool of Bengali conversational speech with human transcripts that we overlooked. The largest admissible conversational addition available is SPRING-INX at ~280 estimated hours, it needs an owner amendment disclosed as a content filter, and whether it moves panel D remains a hypothesis with no supporting evidence.
